title: I was wondering if these packs are actually for MV?

posts.author: lockhowl
posts.body:
Hi, I am using RPG MAKER MZ. However my entire artstyle and asset groups are from RPG MAKER MV because I like the drawings and sprites more.
I was thinking of expanding my generator, so I perused the DLC store to find a few cool expanders.
The problem is, the previews show MZ style assets despite saying they are MV. And some of the screenshots show hints of MV looking assets but I can't tell. The two I'd like to ask about in particular are the following:
Another World Hero Generator for MV
Fill your MV games with more heroes with the help of Another World Hero Generator for MV! Gee-kun-soft is at it again with another set of generator parts remade to fit MV’s style and layout. With 40 male generator parts to choose from, replace your game’s default Harold with a powerful Harry the...
plaza-us.komodo.jp
Another World Heroine Generator 3
MV users, it’s time for you to enjoy the Another World Heroine Generator 3 pack! Gee-kun-soft has remade 41 generator pieces to match MV’s generator and help you make your heroines look exactly how you imagine them.
plaza-us.komodo.jp
Idk if this is allowed to ask, but can anyone show me sampled/watermarked and cropped images of some of the random sprites (perhaps a character made with them)? At the very least give me a guarantee that they are in the MV style!
Additional Question: Are all of the "another world" sets with tagged MV, actually MV style?
Sorry if I sound overly skeptical. 15 bucks is 15 bucks.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
lockhowl said:
Look at the difference in DLC vs MVRTP between the hair you posted and the one I posted. They are clearly not the same? There is a very noticeable shading difference in hair, eye direction and coloring etc. I mean do you disagree with this point or do you think these differences are way too minor?

So you're talking about the way the pictures are actually
painted
, the colors and shading, which was not at all clear to me from your other posts.
You're going to see a
lot
of those kinds of differences based on the individual artist that makes any kind of DLC - whether it's generator parts, map tiles, or enemy battlers. None of them are made by the same artists who drew the RTP.
To me, those are very minor differences that I would never notice during gameplay. If you do notice them, and you dislike the differences, you will have to either only use DLC packs made by the same artists, or get used to touching them up to match the aspects you prefer.
lockhowl said:
Also I did not know there was a refund system.
Click to expand...
I don't know that there's specifically a refund system from Komodo's store - in fact, looking at the store, there explicitly isn't:
Refund policy
RPG Maker Game Development DLC and Asset store. We have a huge selection of the finest tilesets, character packs, battlebacks, animations, character generators, music, voice and sound effects licensed for the RPG Maker Series, Visual Novel Maker and other game engines as well! VX Ace, MV, MZ, VNM.
plaza-us.komodo.jp
But there's "a refund system" on anything that you buy with a credit card. If you purchase something and the product blatantly does not match what's advertised, you refute the charge.
That being said, these minor artistic details that you can see before buying would not be grounds for refuting a charge for any credit card company.

posts.author: JohnDoeGames
posts.body:
I see what you mean though. The eyes kinda look like the faces in MZ RTP. However, I don't think the difference between MV and MZ style is too big. I'd just combine them and have twice as large a library. (But you need both engines to do that.)
I don't even use RTP, but I did make all the MV and MZ graphics, and audio in 1 project, I had to rename many of them (for they had the same name in both rpg makers) but once that was done, I quite a large library of graphics that I thought were all fitting well together.
Using MV generator parts that kinda remind of MZ parts (but are formatted for MV!!), it would just close the gap between the two styles, since you can combine them in a single character.
If you have both engines, and are open to combining the assets, then you can even make characters in MV generator and also in MZ generator and use them both in the same single project.
Oh, and uhm... I also agree: MV assets do look better.

posts.author: lockhowl
posts.body:
Yeah, so it has some places where the mismatch is a bit glaring and bizarre.
Like DLC Front + RTP Back = Fine in Face Bust, Not fine on sprites
RTP Front + DLC Back = Not fine in Bust, Fine on sprites
If a full DLC character and a full RTP character were to talk in the overworld for example, I don't think *that* would be noticeable.
I'll see if adding some color flattening filters would make anything better.
The clothes were all ok *except* one.
This one seems to come from RPG Maker MZ style I'm guessing, top right his arm/sleeve doesn't go together.
Overall more pleased with the outfits still but it's nice to have a few extra variety of hairs.
